evals.prompt: I set up my gRPC server with `grpc.ChainUnaryInterceptor(authInterceptor, loggingInterceptor)`. I expected loggingInterceptor to run first so it logs every request including auth failures, but it doesn't. Why not, and how do I fix the ordering?
evals.expected_output: Explains that ChainUnaryInterceptor runs interceptors outermost-first in the order given, so authInterceptor (listed first) runs before loggingInterceptor, not after. Recommends swapping the order to grpc.ChainUnaryInterceptor(loggingInterceptor, authInterceptor) so logging wraps everything.

assertions.text: Explains the first-listed interceptor is outermost/runs first
Recommends putting loggingInterceptor before authInterceptor in the call

evals.prompt: Write a Go gRPC server-side handler that receives a stream of UploadChunk messages from a client via stream.Recv() in a loop and stops cleanly when the client finishes sending.
evals.expected_output: Loop calls stream.Recv() and treats io.EOF as normal stream completion (break, not an error return), while any other non-nil error is returned wrapped as a status error.

assertions.text: Checks for io.EOF specifically to detect normal stream completion
Does not treat io.EOF as a failure to be returned as an RPC error
